blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At ethereum block 26107704 (0x18e5f38), observed 2026-10-02T22:44:15.796565+00:00, receiveSharesGate, sendSharesGate and receiveAssetsGate were zero and all three setters were abdicated. Reviewed VaultV2 transfer/transferFrom and withdraw/redeem use these gates. sendAssetsGate was the whitelist 0x47c591a3bc346913d0b6bdd96fb50e34efa268aa with its setter not abdicated; it governs deposit/mint, not direct withdrawal or transfer. Deposit-dependent in-kind paths can be constrained by it. USDC freeze exposure is inherited from usdc-circle; this is not a direct share blacklist claim.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: One reviewed native ethereum VaultV2 share deployment; no bridge or separate confidential receipt supply is included. This does not prove absence of uncatalogued integrations.

branches.label: wstETH / steakcUSDC borrower market
branches.summary: Exact engine idToMarketParams matches collateral, oracle and LLTV from the complete adapter inventory. Getter inputs are pinned; source-verified composition does not establish independent fallback, feed-admin closure or heartbeat. Matched Chainlink-oracle source has no elapsed-time round-age rejection; composite feed legs are required, not redundant failover.

feeds.provider: Pinned oracle input; operator/heartbeat not assumed
Pinned oracle input; operator/heartbeat not assumed

branches.fallbackBehavior: No alternative feed is selected by the matched Morpho composition; failed price calls revert borrower valuation/liquidation. Upstream feed availability/freshness and proxy replacement policy remain distinct unverified dependencies.

collateralParameters.note: LLTV verified from exact chain engine idToMarketParams; no additional shutdown ratio inferred.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Morpho liquidate reads this market IOracle.price and rejects healthy positions; an incentivized liquidator repays debt for seized collateral. No timelocked liquidation or guaranteed keeper execution is established.
branches.backstop: The reviewed Morpho lending mechanism does not promise external capital covering realized borrower bad debt; this review establishes no independently funded exact-vault rescue.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: When borrower collateral reaches zero, residual bad debt is deducted from market totalSupplyAssets; adapter realAssets and VaultV2 accrueInterest transmit the loss to the share NAV. No par recovery is promised.
